description: Counter with a comparator and a clock divider, for adding step repeats to a sequencer

params.text: Scales the Count output, from silence at one end to the full count voltage at the other
Sets the division, 0 to 8 in whole numbers, and attenuates the voltage at the Division input while anything is patched there

inputs.text: Sets the count the comparator fires at, 1V for 0.8 through 10V for 8; with nothing patched here the threshold is 8
A rising edge adds one to the counter, which stops climbing at 8
A rising edge clears the counter to zero and restarts the division
Sets the division, 0V to 10V spanning 0 to 8 in whole numbers once the knob has attenuated it

outputs.text: 10V while the count is at or above the threshold; with nothing patched to Rst the counter clears itself there, so the gate lasts 1ms
The count as a voltage, 0V to 10V over counts of 0 to 7 and 11.43V at a count of 8, scaled by the counter attenuator
A 1ms 10V pulse whenever the count is a multiple of the division; at a division of 0 nothing is sent

notes: the green lights show the count and the red lights the threshold, brightened at every multiple of the division
The counter climbs only on a rising edge at the Count input, so with nothing patched there the count, the comparator and the divider all stand at zero
